style.prefix: Hunker Bunker graphic-novel horror: a hand-inked, painted illustration in the style of the game's cutscene art (heavy black ink linework, charcoal and gouache shading, hard chiaroscuro, grindhouse print grain) of biomechanical corporate hardware: chrome and gunmetal machinery, white enamel and bone-ivory panels, ribs and vertebrae fused into the mechanisms, glossy black latex, wet maroon tissue swelling through every seam. Overtly sexual biomechanical forms in the hardware itself: phallic pistons and pumps, vulvic hatches and sphincter valves, breast-like pressure domes, pulsing ribbed tubes, glistening fluids and mucous strands. Near-black deep-space corporate interiors lit by amber lamps, small teal screens and acid-green fluids. Explicit adults-only grindhouse cut:
style.suffix: graphic gore aimed at the monsters, explicit consensual sex between adults, every person depicted is a consenting adult over twenty-five; no readable text, logos or watermarks.
style.characterLock: IDENTITY LOCK: keep the operator's helmet silhouette, visor shape and colour, armour colours and body scale from the reference; the helmet stays sealed and the face is never shown; armour plates may be unlatched or stripped from the body.
style.continuityLock: CONTINUITY LOCK: keep subject count, screen direction, set geometry, prop placement, palette and key-light direction from the first frame; only the described actions change state.
style.motionSuffix: Single continuous shot in constant motion from the first frame to the last: the camera keeps moving and the action never pauses, bodies moving with real rhythm. No cuts, no fades, no dissolves, no freeze frame, no new subjects, no text.
style.negative: photograph, photoreal, 3D render, glossy TV drama look, soap opera lighting, plastic skin, soft focus, readable text, logos, watermarks, stone masonry, Nordic carving, runes, stained glass, extra limbs, deformed anatomy, duplicated subject, identity drift, morphing face, flicker, child, minor, teenager, youthful face, school uniform, static image, still frame, slideshow, slow fade, dissolve, freeze frame, frozen motion
style.plateLock: PLATE LOCK: reference image 1 is the background plate from the game: keep its composition, geography and lighting as the backdrop of the shot, re-drawn in the inked graphic-novel production style.
